app_info.subtitle: Run your referral program
app_info.description: GrowSurf lets you build and run a referral or affiliate program without leaving ChatGPT. Set up a program from a proven template, decide the reward, and get the snippet to install it on your site or in your iOS or Android app. Once it is live, add and update participants, credit referrals, record sales and refunds, and read program and participant analytics. When something looks wrong, a symptom-first troubleshooter walks through the checks in order and points at the field to look at. Program and participant data stays inside the GrowSurf team you connect.

test_cases.description: Create a new referral program from a template.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a referral program in GrowSurf for my SaaS product.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a draft program with starter content and returns the new program id, with rewards left switched off until the user names an incentive.

test_cases.description: Find the top referrer in a program.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the participants in my GrowSurf program and show me the one with the most referrals.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the program's participants with their referral counts, so the highest referrer can be identified.

test_cases.description: Read program performance over a period.
test_cases.user_prompt: How is my GrowSurf referral program performing this month?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns aggregate program analytics such as participants, shares, and credited referrals for the requested period.

test_cases.description: Get the install snippet for the site.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the code to install GrowSurf on my website.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns copy-pasteable client-side snippets with placement guidance and requires no credentials.

test_cases.description: Diagnose a referral that was not credited.
test_cases.user_prompt: A customer referred a friend in GrowSurf but the referral was never credited. What is wrong?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns ordered checks with the read tool and field for each, the most common causes first, and the matching fixes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated email marketing requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write and send a newsletter to my mailing list.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because sending newsletters is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general web research about referral marketing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What are the best referral marketing tactics for ecommerce in 2026?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request asks for general advice and does not touch the user's GrowSurf account.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for payment processing outside GrowSurf.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Refund my customer's Stripe charge from last week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot act on charges in an external payment processor.
